mods.name: AntiStutter
mods.description: Restores 26.2's linear 3-tick entity interpolation (MC-311974) on servers that opt in, such as Loka. Does nothing elsewhere.

releases.notes:
**Fixes 1.0.1 never switching on.** 1.0.1 correctly stayed off on other servers, but it also stayed off on Loka, so it did nothing anywhere. 1.0.2 switches on properly when Loka tells it to. If you grabbed 1.0.1, swap it for this one.

## What it does
- Brings back 26.2's smooth movement for other players and mobs on Loka, fixing the 26.3 stutter ([MC-311974](https://mojira.dev/MC-311974)).
- Only switches on when the server tells it to. On every other server it stays off and doesn't announce itself.
- When Loka switches it on, `latest.log` shows `Server opted in, using linear entity interpolation`.

## Install
1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) 0.19.5+ for Minecraft 26.3.
2. Put [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) and `antistutter-1.0.2.jar` (below) in your `mods` folder, and remove any older AntiStutter jar.

## Credits
Thanks to [SamB440](https://github.com/SamB440), who wrote the original code snippet this mod is built on.

mods.name: AntiStutter
mods.description: Restores 26.2's linear 3-tick entity interpolation (MC-311974) on servers that opt in, such as Loka. Does nothing elsewhere.

releases.notes:
**Update from 1.0.0.** 1.0.0 switched to linear interpolation on every server. Anticheats on other servers that expect 26.3's normal interpolation could then flag your hits, and some players were banned. 1.0.1 fixes that.

## What changed
- AntiStutter now only switches on when the server tells it to. Loka does; other servers don't.
- On every other server it stays off: the game behaves as if the mod weren't installed, and the mod doesn't announce itself.
- When Loka switches it on, `latest.log` shows `Server opted in, using linear entity interpolation`.

## Install
1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) 0.19.5+ for Minecraft 26.3.
2. Put [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) and `antistutter-1.0.1.jar` (below) in your `mods` folder, and remove `antistutter-1.0.0.jar`.

Client-side only, and built for Loka. See the [README](https://github.com/LokaMC/AntiStutter#only-works-on-loka).

## For server and anticheat developers
The mod is switched on by a handshake on the play channel `antistutter:linear_3`. The server registers it first, and the client registers it back. See the [README](https://github.com/LokaMC/AntiStutter#for-server-and-anticheat-developers).

## Credits
Thanks to [SamB440](https://github.com/SamB440), who wrote the original code snippet this mod is built on.

mods.name: AntiStutter
mods.description: Restores 26.2's linear 3-tick entity interpolation (MC-311974) and advertises it to the server so anticheats can account for it.

releases.notes:
Restores 26.2's linear 3-tick entity interpolation on Minecraft 26.3, as the client half of Loka's fix for the stutter on other players introduced by the new stepped interpolation ([MC-311974](https://mojira.dev/MC-311974)).

## Install
1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) 0.19.5+ for Minecraft 26.3.
2. Put [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) and `antistutter-1.0.0.jar` (below) in your `mods` folder.

Client-side only. **On its own, don't expect it to do much:** it was written specifically to pair with [Slice](https://github.com/LokaMC/Slice/tree/26.3), Loka's fork of Paper, which handles the server side of this bug. The two together are what make it work. See the [README](https://github.com/LokaMC/AntiStutter#made-to-pair-with-lokas-server-fork).

**Only download AntiStutter from this page.** Copies on other sites aren't ours.

## For server and anticheat developers
The mod registers the play channel `antistutter:linear_3`. See the [README](https://github.com/LokaMC/AntiStutter#for-server-and-anticheat-developers) for details.

## Credits
Thanks to [SamB440](https://github.com/SamB440), who wrote the original code snippet this mod is built on.
